title: Frequency Balance Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums, identify the longest subarray where each element either appears a single time or in multiples that are either equal or double the frequency of another element within the subarray.
statement: Given an integer array nums, identify the longest subarray where each element either appears a single time or in multiples that are either equal or double the frequency of another element within the subarray.
constraints: A subarray is balanced when it has one distinct value, or its distinct-value frequencies have exactly two levels and the larger is twice the smaller.
Return the maximum balanced subarray length.
hints: Only the frequency multiset matters for a fixed window.
Enumerate left endpoints and extend right while maintaining value counts.
Accept one value, or two frequency levels whose maximum is twice their minimum.
Every candidate window is examined and its maintained counts are exact.
editorial: Every candidate window is examined and its maintained counts are exact.

tests.explanation: A longest valid window has length five with frequency levels in a two-to-one ratio.
A single distinct value is balanced, so the whole array qualifies.
